note_tweet.text:
92% of engineering teams deployed AI surrogate models in 2025. 

Only 8% use them extensively.

That’s from a survey of 350 engineering leaders. 

@McKinsey found the same gap: two-thirds have tried AI simulation, 5% run it at scale.

Where it is used, teams turn simulation requests around 2.8x faster and explore ~4x more design variants.

The demand is there. What’s missing are models accurate and trusted enough for production.

We’re building an open supply of better physics models, backed by independent testing, so engineers can make that move with confidence.
